title: Accounting and Tax Services for Parking Lot Businesses

rows.section: Case study - problem (specified investment business risk)
rows.before: a characterization that would strip the $500,000 Small Business Deduction and tax the first dollar of parking income at the high rate instead of 12.2%.

rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).
